title: Why I eventually cancelled...
text:
Edit 2: My bag finally arrived — I may also be receiving a replacement for it. The November bag is terrible. It includes a bland Doucce Freematic shadow single, a sample sized lip scrub, a pinky Lord & Berry lip crayon... and the fourth product—I cannot stress this enough—is the worst lippie I have received from a beauty sub EVER.

The awful lippie is “Lip Monthly” brand. It’s made in China, which doesn’t automatically mean a product is terrible, but this one is. It’s bubblegum pink. You might like the shade; I tried. There’s no redeeming taste or scent... it’s vaguely unpleasant tasting, but not overwhelmingly so. After one coat, you notice the coverage is terrible. It’s matte, but looks like it needs another coat. So, you’ll kind of let it set and add another. Still not adequate. You wonder if you quickly press your lips together... it’s just so sticky. It kind of gums up into a weird rubbery, boogery paint. It takes a good rubbing with micellar water to remove it — you can skip the lip scrub. This is the first time I have ever just completely thrown a product in the trash and I am a junkie for sub bags/boxes.

Although I am glad that C.S. was willing to replace the stray package, I don’t know why it’s too much to ask for this subscription to ONLY send lip products. And I don’t want their own brand slapped on some 20 cent garbage from China.

Edit 1: so, my most recent bag seems to be a casualty of DHL and its generally rotten shipping. It’s been “out for delivery” for several days in a town that is a few hours away.

I realize that no one can control what happens once a package has shipped (aside from choosing something better than DHL!), but when I contacted the seller about the issue I didn’t receive any kind of resolution.

The fun of these things is lost when you have to go through a bunch of trouble to (maybe) get what you paid for.

~~~~

My first bag had a gloss, lipstick, lip oil, and a liner in it. If I was fond of nudes, I would probably have been more excited, and I can see the appeal of putting complementary shades together. If future bags aren’t more exciting, I don’t see myself paying $12.95/mo.

Would love to see at least one adventurous shade each month — black, green, etc.
label: negative
